text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
BULKERS - Channel Enterprise - (built 1990) 151,380 dwt sold to Japanese buyers for $27.1 million.
Ikan Bilis - (built 1983) 63,800 dwt sold to Chinese buyers for $11 million.
TWEENDECKERS - Anixis - (built 1974) sold to Greek buyers for $1 million.
REEFERS - Reefer Princess - (built 1983) 439,350 cubic ft sold for $11.25 million including three years timecharter.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to inspection, survey or other conditions before completion.
